agent_notes: The official DOAA catalogue is department-wise rather than a single institute-wide active-programme register. The UG admission link delegates to JEE Advanced, several department pages expose generic programme families or older course structures, the CHE Ph.D. section links data_awaited.pdf, and the Humanistic Studies and Mathematical Sciences pages expose course sections rather than unambiguous active degree titles. Therefore the catalogue is partial and the record requires manual review.
Short-term events and certificate/diploma event listings were excluded; no active standalone certificate or diploma programme was established in the official academic catalogue.
Duration and eligibility were left null where the official central catalogue did not explicitly verify them.

Normal curl TLS verification failed with curl error 60 ('self signed certificate in certificate chain') from the managed proxy. After confirming expected public hosts, curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to iitbhu.ac.in, nirfindia.org and Bing discovery pages.
